1.subject: %service_name% is confirmed
1.content:
Hi %customer_full_name%,

Your Dice Dungeon session has been confirmed.

🎲 Session: %service_name%
📅 Date: %appointment_date%
⏰ Time: %appointment_start_time% - %appointment_end_time%

We recommend arriving a few minutes early so your group can get settled and start your session on time.

If you need to modify or cancel your booking, please contact us in advance.

See you soon at Dice Dungeon!

Christoffer, Dice Dungeon

2.subject: %service_name%: booking request received
2.content:
Hi %customer_full_name%,

Your booking request for %service_name% at Dice Dungeon has been received.

📅 Date: %appointment_date%
⏰ Time: %appointment_start_time% - %appointment_end_time%

Your session is waiting for confirmation. We'll check the Game Master's availability and send you a confirmation by email, usually within a day and at most within two business days. Payment is only requested once the session is confirmed.

If you have any questions or need to make changes, simply reply to this email.

We look forward to welcoming you to Dice Dungeon!

Christoffer, Dice Dungeon

3.subject: %service_name%: we couldn't confirm your booking
3.content:
Hi %customer_full_name%,

Unfortunately we can't confirm your booking: %service_name%, %appointment_date_time%, %location_address%.

Usually this means the Game Master isn't available at the requested time. If you'd like, we're happy to suggest another time, just reply to this email.

Christoffer, Dice Dungeon

4.subject: %service_name%: booking cancelled
4.content:
Hi %customer_full_name%,

Your booking has been cancelled: %service_name%, %appointment_date_time%, %location_address%.

If this comes as a surprise, or you'd like to book a new time, reply to this email or book directly at dicedungeon.fi/booking.

Christoffer, Dice Dungeon

5.subject: %service_name%: your booking time has changed
5.content:
Hi %customer_full_name%,

The time of your booking (%service_name%) has changed. The new time is %appointment_date% at %appointment_start_time%, at %location_name%.

If the new time doesn't work for you, reply to this email and we'll find another.

Christoffer, Dice Dungeon

6.subject: Reminder: %service_name% tomorrow
6.content:
Hi %customer_full_name%,

A quick reminder: %service_name% is tomorrow at %appointment_start_time%.

Address: Caloniuksenkatu 9 D 65, 00100 Helsinki (Töölö). Ring the Dice Dungeon doorbell at the gate and I'll let you in. Your own snacks and drinks are welcome.

See you tomorrow!

Christoffer, Dice Dungeon

8.subject: Happy birthday!
8.content:
Hi %customer_first_name%,

Happy birthday from all of us at Dice Dungeon! If you'd like to celebrate around a gaming table, the room is yours to book at dicedungeon.fi/booking.

Christoffer, Dice Dungeon
